description: Purposive visual review of sentence boundaries in the supplied PDFs. Every listed paragraph was checked against its PDF page and compared with the generated sentence records. This is a small exploratory sample, not a corpus-wide gold standard.
method: For each case, visually inspect the full paragraph in the PDF, mark its sentence endings, and compare the expected segmentation with outputs/sentences. The expected count is supplementary; the match judgment is based on the sentence boundaries and retained text.

summary.interpretation: 20/20 exact matches in this deliberately varied, manually selected sample. The sample includes previously observed failure types, technical edge cases, and ordinary prose; it is not random or exhaustive and does not establish 100% accuracy on all pages.
